sources.title: LAION
sources.snippet: LAION Large-scale Artificial Intelligence Open Network TRULY OPEN AI. 100% NON-PROFIT. 100% FREE. LAION, as a non-profit organization, provides datasets, tools and models to liberate machine learning research. By doing so, we encourage open public education and a more environment-friendly use of resources by reusing existing datasets and models.

sources.title: Aion 1.0: Microsoft's On-Device AI Models for Windows (2026)
sources.snippet: Microsoft announced the Aion 1.0 model family at Build 2026 — small AI models designed to run directly on Windows devices without cloud API calls. Two variants: Aion 1.0 Instruct (reasoning and instruction following) and Aion 1.0 Plan (planning, tool use, and agent workflows).
